name: app-teal-bottom-navigation-with-centre-plus-button-in-light-and-dark
title: Teal Bottom Navigation with Centre Plus
whatItIs: Two versions of a five-item bottom navigation (Home, AI Assistant, centre plus, Resources, Profile) with teal active and centre button, the top on white over a mint gradient and the bottom on dark navy over a deep teal gradient, each with a home indicator bar.
whatItMeans: The same teal accent works in light and dark, and the centre plus button gives a clear primary action.
techniques: Teal active tab and centre button
Centre plus button as the main action
Gradient backdrop matched to the theme
bestFor: Apps with a primary create action

vocabulary.definition: A prominent button in the middle of a tab bar.
The thin bar at the bottom of an iPhone screen.
Light and dark versions shown one above the other.
